answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring every identity to post a slashable bond that unlocks only after a season of peer-graded work, like an orchard where a tree must survive a full season before its fruit counts. Each job is tied to one bond by a cipher-signed work log, so whoever tends a garden of fake accounts must fund, staff, and risk every bond separately: one fraudulent vote burns that identity's whole stake. A thousand sockpuppets cost a thousand bonds; honest work costs one.
